A [[Species/Legends|species]] of''' creatures''' lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Vaal/Legends|Vaal]]. They were large, brown land-living quadrupeds with several horns, a partial [[exoskeleton]], large fangs and spiked tails. It is unknown if they were carnivorous or herbivorous. They were hunted by the predatory [[hyenax]].

==History==
[[File:Empire_Vol_3_043.jpg|thumb|left|Darth Vader deals the killing blow on the creature.]]
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], one member of the species was attacked by a pack of hyenax. The creature killed several of them in self-defense, but was ultimately defeated when the pack's new leader [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], who had crash-landed on Vaal shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], came to their aid.
